# drizzle-kit 0.31.7 license evidence

The published `drizzle-kit@0.31.7` package metadata declares `MIT`, but the
package archive and its source subtree do not contain an MIT license text or a
copyright notice. `LICENSE` therefore retains the standard MIT template with
its `<year>` and `<copyright holders>` placeholders instead of inventing a
holder from the package's `author` field.

The npm SLSA attestation resolves the published artifact to commit
`c66862c55abe6cd23e9bf1f07519e3e5c6274cbf`. The root license at that exact
commit is Apache-2.0 and is retained verbatim as `LICENSE-Apache-2.0.txt`.

These are two conflicting upstream signals. Their inclusion here records the
evidence; it does not assert that drizzle-kit is dual-licensed.

- Package metadata: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/drizzle-team/drizzle-orm/c66862c55abe6cd23e9bf1f07519e3e5c6274cbf/drizzle-kit/package.json
- Root license: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/drizzle-team/drizzle-orm/c66862c55abe6cd23e9bf1f07519e3e5c6274cbf/LICENSE
- npm attestation: https://registry.npmjs.org/-/npm/v1/attestations/drizzle-kit@0.31.7
- Build run: https://github.com/drizzle-team/drizzle-orm/actions/runs/19333748116/attempts/3
